input.quote: 2.2 Vendor will be Customer's sole and exclusive provider of hosted analytics services throughout the term.
input.rationale: Section 2.1 correctly states that no minimum quantity or purchase commitment applies and that a decision not to order is not a breach or shortfall, and Section 7.1 bars unstated minimum-use charges. However, Section 2.2 imposes a sole-source exclusivity obligation on Customer for hosted analytics for the whole term, which is a restriction on our purchasing volume equivalent to a de facto commitment and has no reduction or exit right. It also contradicts Section 12.3, which records that Customer has made no exclusivity or minimum-volume commitment. Preferred position is deletion so fees are for ordered or used Services only; deletion is a one-paragraph edit and is proportionate.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] We deleted the sole and exclusive provider obligation because our position is that no minimum commitment or purchasing restriction applies to us and fees are payable only for Services we order or use. This also removes a conflict with Sections 2.1 and 12.3, which confirm we have made no exclusivity or minimum-volume commitment; if Silverline needs volume visibility, we can discuss non-binding forecasts in the Order Form.
proposal.summary: Delete the sole-source exclusivity obligation on Customer in Section 2.2
